entity_merges.note: Substrate-ui's Record IS substrate's Run (its persisted RunRecord, exposed via /api/records/<name>). UI keeps 'Record' for user-facing prose; typed identifiers cite the substrate Run identity by string.
Same primitive, same namespace, same substrate.topologies.bundled registry. The name matches by design.
An AgentRun is a substrate Run whose Topology is the tool-loop shape. Referenced by run_name in agent-category payloads.
The 'event' the user inspects (EVENT_INSPECTED payload) IS the substrate Envelope with fields seq, kind, payload, producer.

Substrate-ui's Spec (the studio's buildSpec() dict) is the untyped author's-intent form of substrate's authored Topology. /api/validate lands it as a msgspec Struct; /api/build instantiates it via builder.py. Filed 2026-08-16 with Sprint 032.

external_vocabulary_ref.purpose: substrate's runtime vocabulary. UI payload fields typed as `substrate_kind` reference the tags[].name closed set in this file. Bridge mapping per TECHNIQUES.md #46.

runtime_operators.name: SubstrateReader
runtime_operators.note: The 500ms poll loop over /api/records/<name> in followLive(). Surfaces AGENT_TURN_STREAMED per cycle with new events; classifies POLL_TIMEOUT when the ceiling is exceeded.

runtime_operators.name: SubstrateController
runtime_operators.note: The POST callers to /api/agent, /api/launch, /api/resume. Surfaces AGENT_LAUNCH_REQUESTED, TOPOLOGY_LAUNCH_REQUESTED, RESUME_REQUESTED and their resolutions.

runtime_operators.name: ReplayEngine
runtime_operators.note: The rAF loop in startPlay/_frame at STATE.speed frames/sec. Surfaces PLAY_STARTED, PLAY_STOPPED, SPEED_CHANGED, and CURSOR_MOVED{source: play_frame}.

runtime_operators.name: AgentTurnAccumulator
runtime_operators.note: streamAgentTurns() consumes fresh ToolCall/ToolResult/FinalAnswer events per poll cycle and emits AGENT_TURN_STREAMED + FINAL_ANSWER_RENDERED.

notes: Substrate-ui is a browser reader AND controller UI over the substrate runtime's records — it reads records via /api/records and CAUSES substrate events via /api/launch, /api/resume, /api/agent. This vocabulary covers user-driven interaction (clicks, tab switches, chat turns), per-pane render events, and the browser-side runtime operators (Layer 6). The vocabulary references substrate's runtime ontology by foreign key (external_vocabulary_ref) — it does not redeclare substrate's tags.

Every pane-category tag inherits pane_payload_universal fields (frame, visible, pane_id, subject_record). subject_record is the record name the pane is rendering, or null for panes that don't read from a record (rail, assay picker, terminal chrome).

The subject invariant: exactly one record is the active subject at a time (STATE.name in current app.ts). RECORD_SELECTED sets it; every pane render tag after that carries the same subject_record until the next RECORD_SELECTED.

Poll cadence: the SubstrateReader operator polls /api/records/<name> at ~500 ms while a run is in flight. AGENT_TURN_STREAMED fires per poll cycle that observes new agent events; POLL_TIMEOUT is the incident-stratum companion if the poll ceiling is exceeded.

The four pane-toggle values (run, topology, scene, io) are the current app.ts's underlying view + mode toggle. Sprint 018 (TS conversion, 2026-08-14) has 'topology' as the tag; a future 'structure' pane would join here.

tags.name: SESSION_INIT
tags.note: First signal on every page load. Anchors every subsequent signal's relative t.

tags.name: SESSION_ENDED
tags.note: Page unload (browser close, navigate away). Best-effort — beforeunload isn't guaranteed to fire.

tags.name: RECORDS_LOADED
tags.note: Rail fetch from /api/records completed. count is total; run_count + demo_count decompose it per the rail's grouping. bucket (optional, added v0.7) is one of sessions | recent | bundles | records; identifies which rail bucket loaded (piece G four-bucket rail).

tags.name: RECORD_SELECTED
tags.note: User clicked a record in the rail (or a deep-link resolved). Sets STATE.name; every subsequent pane render carries this as subject_record. prior_name is the previously-selected record or null. Foreign key: name identifies a substrate Run.

tags.name: RECORDS_PRUNED
tags.note: User clicked the your-runs 'clear' affordance to delete session runs. Demos are preserved server-side.

tags.name: RECORD_LOAD_BEGIN
tags.note: selectRecord kicked off the per-record fetch chain (/api/records/<name>, /run_graph, /summary, /topology_graph).

tags.name: RECORD_LOADED
tags.note: All four projections landed. status is finalised | paused | incomplete | failed. Paired staleness guard: if a newer RECORD_LOAD_BEGIN fires first, this one is dropped.

tags.name: ASSAYS_LOADED
tags.note: Assay list fetched from /api/assays.

tags.name: ASSAY_SELECTED
tags.note: User clicked an assay in the rail.

tags.name: ASSAY_REPORT_LOADED
tags.note: Assay report fetched from /api/assay/<name> and rendered. verdict is the overall margin verdict when earned.

tags.name: PANE_SWITCHED
tags.note: User toggled between run, topology, scene, or io — the four inner-pane values. View-scope container flips (desktop, terminal) fire VIEW_SWITCHED instead (v0.7.1 TAG_SPLIT). Renamed from v0.1 VIEW_SWITCHED to free the word for substrate runtime primitives; v0.7.1 restored the name for the container-flip tag. Closed set enumerated in note per REVIEW-2026-08-28-piece-g-work-so-far H2.

tags.name: CURSOR_MOVED
tags.note: Replay cursor changed. source is drag | button | play_frame | keyboard.

tags.name: PLAY_STARTED
tags.note: Transport play began. Emitted by the ReplayEngine operator.

tags.name: PLAY_STOPPED
tags.note: Transport paused. reason is user_pause | end_reached | scrub_interrupt.

tags.name: SPEED_CHANGED
tags.note: Replay speed (frames/sec) changed.

tags.name: GRAPH_RENDERED
tags.note: Run-as-graph pane repainted. instance_count is the number of producer-instance lanes drawn at the current cursor.

tags.name: TOPOLOGY_RENDERED
tags.note: Static topology-structure pane repainted.

tags.name: SCENE_RENDERED
tags.note: Scene pane repainted (a domain-visual grid inferred from payload shape, e.g. game_of_life).

tags.name: IO_RENDERED
tags.note: I/O pane repainted. Shows seed/baseline as input and terminal-artifact events as outputs.

tags.name: HEALTH_RENDERED
tags.note: Health verdict repainted. verdict is FINALISED | FAILED | PAUSED | INCOMPLETE | LIVE.

tags.name: STREAM_RENDERED
tags.note: Event-stream pane repainted at the current cursor. line_count is rows visible.

tags.name: EVENT_INSPECTED
tags.note: User clicked an event in the stream; inspector shows its payload. kind is a foreign key to substrate v0.2 tags[].name (see external_vocabulary_ref).

tags.name: PRODUCER_INSPECTED
tags.note: User clicked a producer lane in the graph; inspector shows the /explain/<instance> chain. kind is the substrate Producer kind (foreign key to substrate's Producer registry).

tags.name: PRODUCER_INSPECTION_RACED
tags.note: User clicked a producer lane whose kind wasn't yet in STATE.graph.instances — the click landed before the graph fetch settled. The inspector still opens the /explain/<instance> chain; the emit records the race so it stays visible on the record instead of dropping into silence. Companion to PRODUCER_INSPECTED, which fires the normal path.

tags.name: TOPOLOGY_LAUNCH_REQUESTED
tags.note: User clicked launch on a bundled topology name.

tags.name: TOPOLOGY_LAUNCHED
tags.note: POST /api/launch returned a run name; the new record is selected. run_name is a substrate Run identity.

tags.name: RESUME_REQUESTED
tags.note: User clicked resume on a paused run.

tags.name: RESUMED
tags.note: POST /api/resume returned; the record's state advances.

tags.name: STUDIO_OPENED
tags.note: User navigated to /studio.html. via is header_link | direct_url.

tags.name: DIFF_REQUESTED
tags.note: User picked a diff target in the diff selector.

tags.name: DIFF_RENDERED
tags.note: Diff pane repainted with the first-divergence output from /api/diff. Category promoted to 'pane' in v0.2 — the diff surface renders a pane like the other visual tags (not a bare event).

tags.name: FETCH_FAILED
tags.note: An /api/* fetch failed. status_or_error is the HTTP status number or the caught exception message.

tags.name: LAUNCH_REJECTED
tags.note: A launch or resume POST returned an error field. kind is agent | topology | resume.

tags.name: POLL_TIMEOUT
tags.note: Agent-record poll exceeded its ceiling without a FinalAnswer or RunFinalised landing.

tags.name: SPEC_ROW_ADDED
tags.note: User added a row on the studio authoring form. kind is one of producer | view | trigger | route | member.

tags.name: SPEC_ROW_REMOVED
tags.note: User removed a row via its .rm affordance. kind matches SPEC_ROW_ADDED's enum.

tags.name: CANVAS_TOGGLED
tags.note: User toggled the studio's form-vs-canvas view. to is form | canvas.

tags.name: SPEC_VALIDATE_REQUESTED
tags.note: User clicked validate; the current authored spec POSTs to /api/validate.

tags.name: SPEC_VALIDATED
tags.note: Response landed. valid boolean; on false, error carries the SpecError message.

tags.name: SPEC_BUILD_REQUESTED
tags.note: User clicked build; the studio POSTs to /api/build after a re-validate.

tags.name: SPEC_BUILT
tags.note: Build succeeded; a real record now exists. status is finalised | incomplete | paused | failed. run_name is a substrate Run identity.

tags.name: SPEC_BUILD_REJECTED
tags.note: Build failed at validation or execution; reason is non-empty.

tags.name: CONSOLE_LINK_FOLLOWED
tags.note: User clicked the 'view the run in the console' link after a successful build. run_name is the built record.

tags.name: DRIVER_SESSION_STARTED
tags.note: Substrate emitted `SessionStarted` on the record. Pairs with `SessionStarted` per TECH-SPEC-2026-08-25-round6 §13.5. session_id is the substrate Run identity for the driver session; parent_session_id is set when spawned via child_session_name.

tags.name: USER_MESSAGE_INJECTED
tags.note: Substrate emitted `UserMessage` on the record. Pairs with `UserMessage`. turn_index is monotonically increasing per session_id; text_length is character count, not bytes.

tags.name: PARK_LANDED
tags.note: Substrate emitted `Park` on the record. reason is final_answer | model_error | interrupt (matches substrate `Park.reason`). Pairs with `Park`.

tags.name: DRIVER_SESSION_ENDED
tags.note: Substrate emitted `SessionEnded` on the record. reason is user_end_request | max_turns | driver_error | orphan_cleanup. Pairs with `SessionEnded`. Not to be confused with `SESSION_ENDED` (the browser-tab unload signal that predates v0.6).

tags.name: TRANSCRIPT_COMPACTED_LANDED
tags.note: Substrate emitted `TranscriptCompacted` on the record. dropped_seq_start..dropped_seq_end is contiguous and strictly below kept_seq_start (matches substrate `§F` invariant). Pairs with `TranscriptCompacted`.

tags.name: DRIVER_SESSION_WARNING_EMITTED
tags.note: Substrate emitted `SessionWarning` on the record from a `session_warning` producer. condition_kind is seed_alone_exceeds | (future kinds add here). Pairs with `SessionWarning`. Cadence: at most once per (session_id, condition_kind) pair.

tags.name: DRIVER_SESSION_END_REQUEST_ISSUED
tags.note: Substrate emitted `SessionEndRequested` on the record. source is user_command | max_turns_reached | driver_error. Pairs with `SessionEndRequested`. Precedes `DRIVER_SESSION_ENDED` within the same session_id.

tags.name: PANE_SCROLLED
tags.note: Transcript pane repainted with a new bottom cursor. model_reply_ref, when present, is the substrate seq of the `ModelReply` that caused the scroll — this is the structural pairing for substrate `ModelReply` per TECH-SPEC §13.5 (no per-reply named event; the pane repaint IS the render). direction is up | down | end when known. Introduced in v0.6.

tags.name: DRIVER_PATCHED
tags.note: Session driver changed mid-session via PATCH /api/session/<id> {driver}. Fires after the daemon accepts the round-trip. prior_driver is the driver at emit time; matches the CLI /model slash effect.

tags.name: BUNDLE_ATTACHED
tags.note: Session bundle attached — at create-time (POST /api/session {bundle}) or mid-session (PATCH /api/session/<id> {bundle}). Mid-session attach triggers seed re-assembly and a substrate.TranscriptCompacted{reason:"bundle_changed"} envelope on the record. prior_bundle is null on create-time attach.

tags.name: WORKSPACE_SELECTED
tags.note: Session workspace selected at create-time (POST /api/session {workspace, workspace_shape}). Create-only; workspace is immutable per session. workspace_shape is flat | worktree | isolate.

tags.name: TOOLS_RESTRICTED
tags.note: Session tool set restricted via PATCH /api/session/<id> {tools}. tools is a lexicographically sorted array of tool names; empty array means no restriction (full suite). Matches the CLI /tools slash effect.

tags.name: ISOLATE_TOGGLED
tags.note: Session isolate flag set at create-time (POST /api/session {isolate: true}). Create-only. Fires only when the user explicitly sets the toggle; default-off untouched does not emit. Mutually exclusive with workspace_shape=worktree at the daemon.

tags.name: VIEW_SWITCHED
tags.note: Header toggle or Ctrl+backtick flipped between the two piece-G view containers. Closed set for to_view + prior_view: desktop | terminal. No downstream pane-render pairing is contracted for the terminal side (empty until sprint 035); the desktop side re-mounts whatever inner pane STATE.graphView names and one of GRAPH_RENDERED / TOPOLOGY_RENDERED / SCENE_RENDERED / IO_RENDERED must fire per the pairing invariant. subject_record may be null when no record is selected.

tags.name: DRIVER_PARAMS_PATCHED
tags.note: Session driver params (think/max_tokens/timeout/num_ctx) changed via PATCH /api/session/<id> {driver_params}. Fires after daemon accepts the round-trip. params + prior_params are dicts of the four recognized keys (all optional; unset means responder default). Companion to DRIVER_PATCHED (driver-swap) — one tag one contract; do not fold into DRIVER_PATCHED under grammar/PRINCIPLES commitment 1 (avoids the tag polymorphism v0.7.1 TAG_SPLIT retired for PANE_SWITCHED). Prior_params reflects the manifest state at emit time; empty dict means no prior overrides.

invariants: SESSION_INIT is the first signal in any capture.
SESSION_ENDED, when it fires, is the last signal.
RECORDS_LOADED fires before the first RECORD_SELECTED.
Every RECORD_SELECTED is followed within 5s by exactly one RECORD_LOADED with matching name (staleness guard drops earlier in-flight loads).
Pane-category tags carry subject_record; if subject_record is non-null, it equals the STATE.name active at emit time.
SPEC_VALIDATE_REQUESTED is followed within 5s by exactly one SPEC_VALIDATED.
SPEC_BUILD_REQUESTED is followed within 30s by exactly one SPEC_BUILT or SPEC_BUILD_REJECTED.
Frame is monotonically increasing across every pane-category tag in a capture (the shared _paintFrame counter never decreases).
SESSION_INIT is the absolute first signal in the capture, not merely the first in EXPECTED_ORDER.
SESSION_ENDED, when it fires, is the absolute last signal in the capture, not merely the last in EXPECTED_ORDER.

checkSessionBookends: every DRIVER_SESSION_STARTED with session_id S is followed by exactly one DRIVER_SESSION_ENDED with the same session_id within the record lifetime, OR the substrate record status is paused at grader read time.
checkSessionBookends: no repeated substrate.RunStarted on one session_id across resumes (the driver session's session_id is stable across pause/resume; substrate.RunStarted fires once).

checkSessionBookends: every USER_MESSAGE_INJECTED with (session_id S, turn_index N) reaches at least one FinalAnswer OR a substrate.ProducerFailed on the model producer within the same (S, N) pair; the topology's turn_max_steps × model_timeout ceiling bounds the wait.
checkSessionBookends: every PARK_LANDED with reason=final_answer is preceded within the same (session_id, turn_index) by exactly one FinalAnswer emit.
checkSessionBookends: DRIVER_SESSION_WARNING_EMITTED fires at most once per (session_id, condition_kind) pair.
checkSessionBookends: TRANSCRIPT_COMPACTED_LANDED.dropped_seq_end is strictly less than TRANSCRIPT_COMPACTED_LANDED.kept_seq_start (contiguous drop range strictly below kept range).

Every VIEW_SWITCHED{to_view:desktop} is followed within 500ms by exactly one of GRAPH_RENDERED / TOPOLOGY_RENDERED / SCENE_RENDERED / IO_RENDERED with matching subject_record (the desktop container remounts its inner pane on flip-in). VIEW_SWITCHED{to_view:terminal} carries no downstream pane-render pairing (the terminal view is empty until sprint 035).
rationale: 69 tags across 13 categories. v0.7.2 adds one session-control tag DRIVER_PARAMS_PATCHED in the existing driver_session category, motivated by piece-G sprint 032c (SessionManifest.driver_params + PATCH surface) and sprint 035v (terminal-view params drawer + /set slash). Strict superset of v0.7.1; every prior tag / invariant / entity_merge carries over. Grammar rule 3 ratification: NEW_TAG_PROPOSED, not TAG_EXTEND — folding into DRIVER_PATCHED would recreate the tag polymorphism v0.7.1 TAG_SPLIT retired. One tag, one contract. Architect ratified 2026-08-28.
